Preserve the head and face exactly at their current size and proportions. Widen only the chest, belly and body silhouette by approximately 18–22%, with softly rounded sides. No giant bulging belly, no extreme obesity, no fat rolls, no outward flared hips. The body should remain a distinct simple rounded shape under the face.
